reviews.t: If they had 10 stars that's what I would have rated
reviews.x: This product is amazing.  I am almost 65 and have had trouble with blackheads on my nose.  That's the only place I get them.  They were impossible to remove until I tried this product.  I have only been using it for 5 days and my problem has been solved.  No More Blackheads.  My pores are noticeably smaller and the ugly blackheads are completely gone. The skin become soft after use so you don't have to put moisturizer on after just getting everything off.  Might not be the same for everyone - I

This stuff works, plain and simple. After only several uses, my nose blackheads have disappeared. I have struggled with them, and finding a solution, for years. Don't scrub too harshly. Go gently in a circular motion. If, after several uses, there are still blackheads remaining, press out gently. The cleanser will have loosened them significantly.

More Than Clean is a combination scrub and masque recommended for morning use.  You work it into your skin for a couple of minutes, then leave it on for a few minutes before rinsing it off.  There are no unpronounceable ingredients in it, and it smells like peppermint.  It's a very thick bilious colored liquid dispensed through the bottle cap.  I've used it four times with great results on my skin and one unexpected but welcome side effect.  The MTC initially feels like mud, but there's a really

This is a truly amazing product. I have fought blackheads on my chin and nose all my life. I am 63. This product got rid of the blackheads in 2 days and now the pores are closing up. Better late than never. Will show product to my dermatologist. She won't believe it.

If you are like me and suffer from adult acne or any acne really, you will notice some flair ups. You have to decide which is more annoying, blackheads or some acne. It also shrinks and tights your pores but don't expect a miracle here. I would recommend this. I plan on buying more. It's expensive for how much you get but I only use a little everyday. reviews.t: great product, great texture, great smell  – not only are my pores smaller, my skin feels so much cleaner and smoother
reviews.x: I am hooked on this.  Love the fact that it’s all natural.  I was not seeing immediate results - but after a few weeks my pores are now noticeably smaller and it really did a good job cleaning and unclogging my pores.  But I recommend using this every other day during winter – probably too potent for daily use.  Oh – how could I forget!  I see no trace of any blackheads – so this also works to keep them away!

reviews.t: but that's because there's a crap load of mint oil or something in it so ...
reviews.x: This product seems to be a SCAM. I bought it because I wanted a safe, painless way to remove blackheads. It says right on the label that it's a "blackhead remover." I've been using it everyday for two weeks with absolutely NO difference in my skin. Yes, my skin tingles when I use it, but that's because there's a crap load of mint oil or something in it so it will seem like it's doing something. But, in reality, it's NOT. My blackheads are still intact and show no signs of going anywhere.

Nothing amazing or special about this product. It's REALLY overpriced and I see no difference at all. When it comes to my skin, I'm happy to spend a lot more than $40 for a good product that actually works but this one just isn't and for what it is and the size of the bottle it's, to my opinion a real waste of money.

This product did nothing to my blackheads. I have a combination skin, with blackheads only on my nose and some on my chin. I have been using this product as directed for more than a week now and I do not see any difference in the appearance of my blackheads. Will still keep using it until I finish the bottle hoping that it will work eventually, but looks like I am not going to buy another bottle of this useless product.

reviews.t: First time user, customer for life.
